usedFor: Dribbble holds your team's shots and projects, and Slack gets a “Send Direct Message” when “New Shot Added” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Shot Added” in Dribbble, then “Send Direct Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Someone is told about each new shot directly, so design work is seen without anyone checking Dribbble.

watchOut: “New Shot Added” is polling, so the message lands after a scheduled check, not when the shot is posted.
